summary: Iteration 35: Comprehensive testing of NexusOps batch features - Invoice PDF, Proxmox, Acronis, Gradient MSP, Financial Reports, Ticket Attachments, Device Chat. All backend APIs passing (42/42), all frontend pages loading and functional.

minor.issue: Duplicate route in infrastructure.py was returning empty array instead of demo data - FIXED by adding demo data generation to infrastructure.py route

issues: Console warnings about Recharts chart dimensions (-1 width/height) - cosmetic only, charts render correctly

critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate routes for /proxmox/vms existed in both infrastructure.py and proxmox.py - consolidated demo data logic to infrastructure.py to fix empty VM list issue
seed_data_creation: Demo VMs generated dynamically from client list when proxmox_vms collection is empty
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 10 batch features tested and working. Proxmox VMs now return demo data. Acronis shows 10 customers linked to NexusOps clients. Gradient MSP shows 41 reconciliation items. Financial Reports has 8 tabs with charts. Ticket Files tab shows 2 attachments. Device chat API fully functional with typing status and PDF export.

mocked_apis.Proxmox: Simulated VM management with demo VMs generated from client list
mocked_apis.Acronis: Simulated customer/subscription data linked to NexusOps clients

invoice_pdf.details: PDF generation working, returns >24KB, both preview and download endpoints functional

proxmox_page.details: VM list with 8 VMs, action buttons (Start/Reboot/Shutdown/Stop), 3 tabs (VMs/Backups/Schedules)

acronis_page.details: 10 customers, sync button, subscriptions tab, linked client dropdown

gradient_page.details: 41 reconciliation items, 8 revenue opportunities, KPI cards (Total Billed/Actual Usage/Missed Revenue)

financial_reports_page.details: All 8 tabs present (Revenue/P&L/AR Aging/By Client/By Service/Collections/Tax/Allocations), KPI cards (MRR/ARR/Revenue/Collected/Outstanding)

ticket_attachments.details: Files tab visible with 2 attachments, upload button present, download/delete icons

device_chat_api.details: Send message, get messages, typing status, mark read, unread count, PDF export all working

sidebar_links.details: Gradient MSP and Financial Reports links present in sidebar
